description: This Java source file defines the UnresolvedPlaceholderException class, which is an immutable exception class used to indicate that a placeholder could not be resolved in the context of the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes static factory methods, a builder class, and references to other core classes such as DittoRuntimeException and DittoHeaders.

classes.name: UnresolvedPlaceholderException
classes.description: A specialized runtime exception indicating that a placeholder could not be resolved, immutable, with builder support, part of the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an UnresolvedPlaceholderException from a message string and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an UnresolvedPlaceholderException from a JSON object and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the exception with the specified DittoHeaders.
